To ensure that your work will not be used at Fluence, we’ve made it unrelated to healthcare: Build “LendLoop”: a neighborhood tool-lending board with automated workflows A simple app where neighbors list tools they are willing to lend, request to borrow from each other, and receive automated notifications and reminders handled by n8n. Stack Next.js (App Router) Clerk for authentication Convex for data + backend logic n8n (self-hosted via Docker or n8n Cloud) for workflow automation TypeScript Requirements Public page The fictional company name is LendLoop . Approve or decline requests on their own tools. Mark a loan as returned. Show: All tools with availability status, filterable by category. “My listings”, “My requests”, and “Incoming requests” views. Implement the above role-based access control with best practices, enforced in Convex functions, not only in the UI.
